summary: First E2E smoke test on Divimero. Backend auth, portfolio, market data, feed, likes, comments, follow, and the critical publication-snapshot immutability all pass. Frontend golden demo journey (Landing hero -> Demo Deniz login -> Feed -> Portfolio -> Compose -> Mobile bottom nav) works end to end. One MEDIUM issue: Ece's post-create with disclosure returns disclosure=null instead of storing a 0% snapshot.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates user and returns token
POST /api/auth/login with deniz@divimero.com/demo1234 returns token; wrong password -> 401

GET /api/portfolio (Deniz): total_value=208500, cash=107755, 5 holdings incl. THYAO with allocation 2.6978% and correct FIFO unrealized_pl (GARAN 3090, BIMAS 1210, ASELS 1840, TUPRS 1360, THYAO 441.66)

IMMUTABILITY: after POST /api/portfolio/transactions sell of 3 THYAO, portfolio allocation dropped to 2.2482%, but disclosure.disclosed_allocation_pct on existing posts remained 2.6 and 6.18 unchanged; current_position updated to 2.2482
POST /api/posts/{id}/like flips liked state; likes_count updates in /api/feed
POST /api/posts/{id}/comments adds comment; GET returns it with author (Ece)
POST /api/users/deniz.yatirim/follow toggles; followers_count updates and is_following reflects state
Landing page renders hero PositionDisclosureCard with 'Yayinlandiginda %5.20 / Guncel %2.60 / Azaltti' exactly
hero-demo-deniz button logs in and redirects to /feed with success toast 'Demo hesabina giris yapildi'
Feed shows Turkish content and Deniz THYAO thesis with published vs current allocation and Azaltti indicator
Portfolio page shows TOPLAM DEGER 208.500,00, NAKIT, NET YATIRIM, TOPLAM K/Z KPI cards, line chart, and holdings table incl. THYAO
Compose page: switch-attach toggles, disclosure-ticker select present
Mobile 390px viewport: bottom nav has nav-feed, nav-portfolio, nav-profile

failed.issue: When Ece (no THYAO holding) creates a post with disclosure {ticker: THYAO, show_allocation:true, allocation_mode:exact}, response and later /api/feed return disclosure=null. Spec requires the 0% snapshot to still be stored.
failed.evidence: POST /api/posts returned id but disclosure=null; GET /api/feed for same post id shows disclosure:null and current_position:null

failed.issue: Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on Portfolio page. Chart still renders correctly, cosmetic.

action_items: Fix POST /api/posts so that when disclosure is provided but user has 0 quantity of the ticker, a snapshot is still stored with underlying_allocation_pct=0 (per spec: 'empty portfolio => 0% allocation is acceptable but snapshot must still be stored').
Optional: set explicit min height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer on Portfolio page to silence width/height=-1 warning.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; Deniz/Ece demo1234 valid; admin123 for admin.
